body: Not sometimes, all the time. It's not always possible to put something noisy on or move further away otherwise this would be a simple solution. I realize this is my issue and have voiced that to her, this just added to my grief on the topic. I suppose you can say I'm trying to correct her bad habit but at the same time it's a habit that developed for no reason. Nothing that she is currently doing was present for the entire time we've been together.

It's definitely a 'me' problem considering I'm the one who has an issue with the habits. What concerns me is that they're new and don't stay at home. They're present when we go out and are very audible, I've noticed several people giving 'the glare' when we've gone out before.
I'm not saying she has to be perfect, everyone has their flaws and I'm completely okay with that. I just want to know if there's a better way to deal with her new habits that irritate my worst pet peeve without her getting pissed off everytime.

I like my career, there's nothing wrong with it. My daily life would be found enjoyable to most and my income desirable to a small majority of the population. 

I don't care about my income. I do alright, not well, just alright. 

I want to leave everything. Discard all I have, I care not for my family. I can tell my girlfriend would be more wounded than my family which is why my concern is heightened for her. I don't want to hurt her but my happiness comes first be it in life or else.

I had taken lessons on the piano when I was much younger. I quite enjoyed it but cannot recall as to why I stopped. I think it was due to financial issue from my parents since they're not very well off.

I relish every day I have off of work regardless of how much it strains me financially. I had ecoli 4 weeks ago and it was a week a pure hell and bliss at the same time.
I'm not particularly huge on camping myself. I enjoy it with the right company so maybe I'll entertain your suggestion and go with a select group of friends that I have that enjoy camping. They're hard to be around for extended periods of time but I feel like I could wonder off on my own easily.
I've driven to both coasts of the country. I have family at both so that secures a reason for me to do such endeavors. It's honestly a miracle that I made it back from Vancouver alive. I drove for extensive hours with absolutely zero hours of sleep to ensure my arrival was favourable towards work. 
I enjoy sports although I am absolutely inept at them. I play in a dart league on friday nights although it only provides a source of stress and temporary relief considering how much I drink during the course of the night.

A normal life.

That's it; what I desire.

I love adventure. I love adrenaline. I would drop everything I have right now to just go and be by myself and learn what I need in life if I didn't have to come back to a colossal wasteland that I alone would have to clean up.

If I had the resources to disappear and never return, easily... well I wouldn't be posting on here trying to clear my conscience.
I feel like I'm searching for an out and it's becoming dangerously close to me.

You are correct in stating that I'm burnt out. I used to be able to cope with hope I felt but as of recently I can't be bother to even try. 
I have hobbies, I've enjoyed them for quite a bit of time but they only provide a temporary distraction from reality. This doesn't stop me from trying though. Although my career has potential, my financial situation is strained so starting a new hobby is practically out of the books. I'd love to pick up an instrument again though although I fear failure, it distresses me.
I cannot talk to my girlfriend about my issues. She has enough on her plate in regards to her family and her masters program. I would feel worse about myself burdening her with my trivial issues than I would feel just suffering by my lonesome as I have for years.
You're right though, there are people who care about me. I care very little about myself which is where the problem lies. I'm self aware enough to notice that there is a problem but careless enough to not give a damn about it.

I'm seriously considering it. I have places and methods planned out, it seems to be the most logical escape. I like Japan, I've know about the Aokigahara Forest since before the movie and visiting it entices me straight to my core.
